description: Compose components into the 80/20 responsive game screen.
acceptance_criteria: Behavior matches the requirement acceptance criteria

preserve: game/src/** engine, systems and state modules unchanged

definition_of_done: Files in code_paths implemented and type-check passes

steps.action: Export GameLayout({scene: ReactNode, story: ReactNode}) with useState drawerOpen=false; render main.scene-area with scene, a button 'Story' with aria-expanded={drawerOpen} toggling it, and aside.story-panel with className drawer-open when drawerOpen.

Export default App using useGame; useState started=false; show IntroScreen when state.history.length===0 && !started (onBegin sets started true); otherwise GameLayout with SceneView, ActionMenu for the selected object and StoryPanel using getActiveNode(state, scene).

Define .game-layout grid 4fr 1fr, .story-panel overflow-y auto height 100vh, and @media (max-width: 768px) rules making .story-panel position fixed bottom 0 max-height 50vh transform translateY(calc(100% - 3rem)) with .drawer-open translateY(0).
Create index.html with div#root and script type=module src=/src/main.tsx.
Import './styles.css' and render <App/> into #root with createRoot.
